name: Word Fuse
hook: Type a word with the letters before the bomb pops.
how: The bomb shows two or three letters: on your turn, type any word that contains them and hit Enter to pass it on. No repeats, two lives each, last one standing wins.
controls: Type on the keyboard (or your phone's keyboard) and press Enter or GO
uses: Games won, all time, shown on the results card.
Bots fill the circle, type at a human pace and sometimes blunder.
The host's browser checks every word and runs the hidden fuse; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone watches the letters appear as the player with the bomb types.
ideas: Make the bomb a ticking alarm clock in a spooky castle
Give a bonus life for words longer than 8 letters
Add a category round where every word must be an animal
